direct_edges.return_semantics: IFC-state-dependent; ordinary call-stack semantics are not assumed

ifc_return_sites.target_status: IFC-state-dependent return or fallthrough; not resolved here

control_flow.scope: Explicit transfer targets including verified EX9 J/JAL effects; no full IFC state simulation.

limitations: EX9 instruction-table entries remain external Agent 18 dependencies; their bytes are not generated by this span.
The interval is a partial firmware reconstruction; byte equality does not establish complete high-level semantics or hardware execution.
The inherited routine prefix before file 0x66a is not rebuilt by this verifier.
IFCALL9 targets and IFRET16 sites are recorded, but nested/implicit IFC return state is not simulated.
